subject: Announcing the 2025 NASA Space Apps Challenge Global Winners
snippet:
Dear Local Leads,
 
 
 We are pleased to announce the 2025 NASA Space Apps Challenge Global Winners
 <https://www.spaceappschallenge.org/2025/awards/global-winners/>! These 10
 teams were chosen out of more than 11,500 project submissions for their
 innovative responses to challenges authored by NAS
